label: 本工具适配版 HumanEval+：求根数值判分 v1
predicate: For finite binary64 x: abs(P(x)) <= 1/10000 + gamma_d * S(x)

definitions.P: sum(a_i*x^i), evaluated with exact rational arithmetic
definitions.S: sum(abs(a_i*x^i)), evaluated with exact rational arithmetic
definitions.d: effective polynomial degree after trimming zero leading coefficients

basis: For a normal-domain exact root r rounded to x with abs(x-r)<=u*abs(r), the root representation residual is bounded by ((1-u)^(-d)-1)*S <= gamma_d*S. The fixed predicate is defined for every finite x; the explanatory relative-rounding guarantee does not automatically extend to subnormal roots.
limit: This is a tool-specific numerical adaptation, not equality with the official original oracle and not a root-distance error guarantee.
reference: Conformance uses a separately verified fixed scan/bisection/ULP reference because the published canonical has two remaining convergence failures even after the numerical correction. Production scores always evaluate the original model answer.
